messages.text: Heads up: the noon ACH origination file to our ODFI got rejected. PaymentsGateway shows status REJECTED_FILE, no batches accepted. Looking at the return now.
Seeing it too. PaymentsGateway alert fired at 12:01 ET, file-level reject from the bank. Craig, do you have the reject reason code?
Yep, it's a file header error, immediate origination field is wrong. Looks like the header record has the wrong format. Bank said the file failed at record 1, so nothing was processed.

Declaring this SEV3 for now. Impact: same-day ACH batch from this morning not sent, roughly 140 payments queued. No wires affected, WireRoom is fine. I'll own the incident, Angelica can you dig into the file generator?
On it. Pulling the generated file from the gateway's outbound spool and diffing against the last accepted one from Friday.
Recon side: this will show as unmatched in the ACH settlement comparison tonight if it's not resubmitted. I'll hold off flagging breaks until we know the new send time.

Found it. The header's destination routing field got a trailing space padded in. Config change deployed this morning at 07:40 touched the bank profile template and dropped the field trim. Friday's file was clean.
Ugh, that's from the profile refactor. Can you revert the template and regenerate? Don't touch the batch contents, just the header.
Reverting template now, PR is small. Will regenerate from the same batch set so the entries and totals stay identical.
Called the bank ops desk. Same-day window cutoff for the next ACH window is 14:45 ET, so we have time if the file goes out before that.
Revert merged and deployed to PaymentsGateway. Regenerated file, trim is back. Header fields check out against the bank's spec and Friday's file.
Can you give me the control totals? I want to confirm entry count and total dollar amount match the original batch before I transmit.
Entry count 142, total credits $1,284,615.20, total debits $1,284,615.20. Matches the original build log exactly.
Transmitted the corrected file at 13:01 ET, bank acknowledged and accepted. All batches show ACCEPTED in PaymentsGateway.
Great. I'll expect settlement on the next business day cycle and will tag today's items as delayed, not broken, in the recon sheet. No downstream impact on TradeBlotter or GL that I can see.

Downgrading to resolved. Root cause: header trim dropped by this morning's bank profile template change. Follow-ups: add a pre-send header validation check and a unit test on the template. Angelica, can you file tickets?
Will do. I'll file both tickets today and add a validator that blocks transmission on any header spec mismatch. Writing it up in the incident doc too.
